title: Zelenskyy says Starshield restrictions are affecting only Ukraine, leading him to believe they are a "planned operation" rather than technical issues (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Zelenskyy says Starshield restrictions are affecting only Ukraine, leading him to believe they are a “planned operation” rather than technical issues — Restrictions on Ukraine's military use of SpaceX's Starlink system appear to be deliberate and not the result of any technical problems …
